### Hope to Obey Hard Commands
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/hope-to-obey-hard-commands
Passage: 1 Peter 3:10-11
Points:
- Disobedience stems from a lack of confidence that following Christ brings greater blessing than sinning.
- Scripture motivates Christians to turn from evil by promising eternal joy rather than temporary vengeance.
- Obeying Jesus is always ultimately better for believers, even when obedience brings earthly loss or hardship.
- The power to practice costly, non-retaliatory love comes from confident hope in God's eternal reward.
